scenes.title: Parma lab loudspeaker firing identical spike bursts as an articulated porcelain macaque sits motionless watching a precision pinch on a raisin
scenes.era: 1992, University of Parma Institute of Human Physiology, Italy

layout.description: Sunlit 1992 Italian neurophysiology laboratory with a wooden testing tray holding small raisins, a benchtop audio spike monitor speaker and dual-trace green oscilloscope ('F5 Neuron Spikes' top trace, 'Arm Muscle EMG = Flat 0' bottom trace).

positions.where: seated completely still with both hands resting calmly on the chair rail while watching the tabletop tray

positions.who: Giacomo Rizzolatti / Luciano Fadiga (mannequin in crisp 1992 white lab coat)
positions.where: reaching smoothly across the wooden tray with thumb and index finger in a precision pinch to pick up a single raisin

props.name: wooden testing tray with raisins & empty-air comparison zone
props.period_detail: clean maple tray holding individual dark raisins
props.physical_behavior: reaching for a real raisin fires intense F5 spikes; empty-air miming stays quiet

props.name: dual-trace oscilloscope ('SPIKES HIGH / ARM MUSCLE FLAT')
props.period_detail: crisp benchtop screen showing dense vertical F5 action-potential ticks directly above a dead-flat arm-muscle EMG line

props.name: benchtop audio spike monitor speaker
props.period_detail: brushed-metal speaker box beside the oscilloscope
props.physical_behavior: crackles alive the exact millisecond the researcher's fingers close on the raisin

actions.verb_sequence: sits with hands completely still on the armrest (EMG flat) -> Researcher reaches out and pinches a raisin off the wooden tray -> F5 spike trace erupts identically to an active grasp
mimes the exact same finger pinch in empty air beside the tray -> F5 spike trace stays completely silent

reactions.reaction: turns to the oscilloscope stunned that a 'motor' cell cared about a watched goal
remains calmly attentive with zero arm movement

scenes.wardrobe: 1992 Italian academic lab attire: white cotton lab coat over collared shirt and tie; animal subject strictly rendered as an articulated matte-white porcelain macaque sculpture.
scenes.lighting: Warm, high-key Italian window daylight across maple wood and clean instruments.
scenes.recognition_hook: With arm sensors dead flat proving not a single muscle twitched, a 'movement' cell in Parma crackled over the speaker the instant a scientist pinched a raisin.

key_visual.description: a 1992 Parma scientist in a white lab coat pinching a raisin off a wooden tray in front of a motionless articulated matte-white porcelain macaque beside a spiking oscilloscope

scenes.title: Opaque screen test: Hidden apple still fires the goal neuron

layout.description: Same wooden tray, now fitted with a small sliding white screen placed in front of a red apple.

positions.where: showing the apple first, sliding the white screen in front, and reaching behind the screen

props.name: small sliding white occluder screen & apple
props.period_detail: hides the final finger contact from sight
props.physical_behavior: proves F5 neurons code inferred goal, not just raw pixels

actions.verb_sequence: places apple behind screen -> reaches behind -> oscilloscope fires right at inferred grasp moment

reactions.reaction: contrasts that burst against zero firing when reaching behind an empty screen

scenes.wardrobe: White lab coats; porcelain macaque sculpture.
scenes.recognition_hook: Hide the apple behind a screen and reach in — the neuron STILL fires, unless it knows the screen is empty.

scenes.title: Hickok's Reality Check: Separating motor resonance from 'explaining everything'

layout.description: Sunlit lecture desk displaying two clear columns: 'Proven: Motor Prediction & Imitation Learning' vs 'Debunked Myth: Broken Mirrors Cause Autism / Sole Seat of Meaning'.

positions.where: pointing to intact action-comprehension scores in frontal-lesion patients

actions.verb_sequence: places a green check beside sensorimotor prediction and crosses out 'explains all civilization'

scenes.recognition_hook: Science self-corrects: mirror neurons tune motor prediction and skill learning, NOT magical telepathy or 'broken-mirror' myths.

scenes.title: Alternating watch-then-do reps on a guitar fretboard

layout.description: Sunlit studio with two acoustic guitars where a teacher plays a slow chord transition and the student immediately executes the matching grip.

positions.where: demonstrating a clean three-finger chord change slowly at eye level
watching fingers closely then executing the exact chord cleanly

props.name: two natural-wood acoustic guitars
props.physical_behavior: couples visual observation with immediate motor execution

actions.verb_sequence: plays slow chord -> Student mirrors finger placement immediately

reactions.reaction: locks the chord cleanly on the second rep

scenes.recognition_hook: Pairing close observation with immediate physical reps wires Heyes's sensorimotor loop fastest.
